Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Most people pick their affiliate offer in about four minutes and then spend a year wondering why the content isn't working.

Three questions decide it:

1. Does it pay recurring? A one-time payout puts you back at zero every month. Recurring pays you for work you already did.

2. Do you actually use it? You can't make faceless content about a tool you've never opened — the demo IS the content.

3. How long is the attribution window? Thirty days minimum. Under seven days and you're doing the work for someone else's brand.

Shortlist three, read the terms, commit to one for ninety days.
